payload.reason: The evidence provides specific pretrained word embeddings used in the experiments, including Edinburgh embeddings and GloVe embeddings, as well as Emoji embeddings.

claims.text: The pretrained word embeddings used include Edinburgh embeddings, GloVe embeddings, and Emoji embeddings.
Edinburgh embeddings outperform GloVe embeddings in certain emotion categories.
Emoji embeddings provide better results than plain GloVe and Edinburgh embeddings.
